name: Research Roam
description: Journal-style academic typesetting: Latin Modern, a numbered abstract, tight measure, IEEE-flavoured bracket citations. Emits report.tex alongside, so you can build it with Typst, Tectonic or pdflatex if you have one installed.
notes: The LaTeX path is preferred when a TeX engine is on PATH; otherwise the HTML shell renders through headless Edge and is designed to look near-identical.
